title: WalletEligibilityChanged
description: An organization's wallet started or stopped being allowed to receive offers. One event per user of the organization, or a single event with a null `user_id` when billing knows no user of it yet. `side` says which: realtime acts only on carriers, goway-loads refuses posting for shippers.

event_id.description: Unique id of this event, stamped by the publisher's outbox. Consumers dedupe on it.

user_id.description: Null when billing's replica holds no user of the organization.

balance.description: Wallet balance in so'm; negative means debt.

debt_limit.description: How far below zero the balance may go, so'm.

reason.description: Why offers stopped; null when the wallet is eligible.

side.title: WalletSide
side.description: Whose wallet: a carrier's stops instant offers past the debt limit; a shipper's stops posting new loads at any debt.
